title: Shell (PowerShell & Bash)
philosophy: Automate the computer you already use every day — PowerShell-first on Windows, where every lesson does something real to files, data, or the web, plus enough bash to feel at home on any server or container.

units.title: Meet the Shell
units.summary: The terminal, cmdlet grammar, navigating and managing files.
topics: what a shell is: terminal, prompt, and why PowerShell 7 (vs Windows PowerShell)
the Verb-Noun grammar: guessing commands you've never seen
discovering commands: Get-Command and Get-Help
navigating: Get-Location, Set-Location, absolute vs relative paths
listing files: Get-ChildItem with -Recurse and -Filter
creating and reading files: New-Item, Set-Content, Add-Content, Get-Content
copying, moving, renaming, deleting: Copy-Item, Move-Item, Rename-Item, Remove-Item
aliases (dir, ls, cd) and why full names win in scripts
wildcards, Test-Path, and Join-Path
mini-project: tidy a messy downloads folder from the command line

units.title: Pipelines and Objects
units.summary: The pipeline of objects: select, filter, sort, group, transform.
topics: the pipeline: sending output down the line with |
everything is an object: Get-Member and properties (not text!)
Select-Object: picking properties, -First and -Last
Where-Object: filtering with script blocks and $_
Sort-Object and Measure-Object
ForEach-Object: transforming each item
Group-Object: counting and bucketing

units.title: Variables, Operators, and Flow
units.summary: Variables, strings, operators, arrays, hashtables, control flow.
topics: variables and $-syntax; types and casting with [int] and [string]
strings: single vs double quotes, interpolation, here-strings
comparison operators: -eq, -ne, -lt, -gt, -like, -match (and why not ==)
logical operators: -and, -or, -not
if / elseif / else and switch
arrays: creating, indexing, adding, iterating
hashtables: keys, values, and lookup tables
foreach, while, and do loops
loops vs the pipeline: when to use which
mini-project: console quiz game with a hashtable question bank and a score

units.title: Functions, Scripts, and Parameters
units.summary: Functions, param blocks, .ps1 scripts, error basics; ends with the Core capstone.
topics: defining functions: inputs, output, and return behavior
param() blocks with types and default values
switch parameters and validation attributes
scope: local, script, and global
from console to .ps1: writing and running scripts, execution policy
comment-based help: making your tools self-documenting

building a personal toolkit with $PROFILE

topics: string methods: Split, Replace, Trim, Substring, PadLeft

anchors, alternation, and grouping
-match and $Matches: pulling data out of strings

-replace with regex and substitution patterns

units.title: Data: JSON, CSV, and APIs
units.summary: CSV, JSON, PSCustomObject, REST APIs with Invoke-RestMethod.
topics: Import-Csv and Export-Csv: files become object pipelines
